independent_digest_publication.policy: Publish the signed baseline SHA-256 through Cosign and preserve the returned log identity, index/entry locator, inclusion proof and any timestamp-authority evidence. Do not assume a specific Rekor API generation.

preservation_plan.discovery: Publish the project ID, baseline digest and exact object-version locators in the release and independent archive receipt. A mutable latest pointer is discovery only, never the trust anchor.

freeze_requirements: Recheck the configured independent archive at freeze and verify retention and public downloads of the actual baseline artifacts; the setup probe alone does not establish those future results.
